items.lede: Microsoft just posted the first quarter of its 2027 fiscal financial results. The software maker made $92.3 billion in revenue and a net income of $33.6 billion during Q1. Revenue is up 19 percent, and net income has increased by 32 percent. It's a new financial year for Microsoft, so the company is changing up […]
items.title: Microsoft reveals strong cloud growth amid financial reporting overhaul

items.lede: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.
items.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record- breaking revenue in a row

items.lede: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
items.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI

items.lede: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.
items.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
